name: engineering-agent-skills
description: Project entry and recurring design-document discovery for agent-executed engineering, plus optional integrated verification and release.

interface.shortDescription: Discover confirmed designs; agent executes, governance verifies
interface.longDescription: project-bootstrap supports greenfield and source-first existing project adoption, establishes a stable AGENTS.md link to a living index of confirmed requirements, constraints and approved designs, and maintains rules only when justified. Grill and Wayfinder can clarify new important design decisions repeatedly through a project's life; the agent directly executes confirmed solutions. engineering-governance provides optional integrated verification and reproducible releases.
defaultPrompt: Use project-bootstrap for a new project, create a project-document index and link it from AGENTS.md; leave unconfirmed designs pending.
Use project-bootstrap to inspect this existing codebase, establish its current facts, confirmed requirements and constraints, and a project index of effective design documents.
Use Grill or Wayfinder when a new important design choice arises; after acceptance, have the agent update the authoritative design and project index, then execute directly.
Use project-bootstrap add-rule to maintain approved, evidenced rules inside .agents/rules/ without editing AGENTS.md.
Use engineering-governance verify or release when system integration or reproducible delivery is needed.
